title_en: Korea Student Aid Foundation: Job Fair for Hope Ladder Scholarship Recipients
summary: The Korea Student Aid Foundation, together with various partner organisations, is holding a job fair to support employment and business start-ups among Hope Ladder scholarship recipients. Eligible students are asked to participate. The date, venue and registration details are not stated in the notice text; they may be in the two attached images (a poster and a web flyer for the 2026 Mid-sized Enterprise Job Fair in Daejeon), which were not read.
applies_to: Students who are Hope Ladder (희망사다리) scholarship recipients of the Korea Student Aid Foundation. Participation is requested, but the notice does not state that it is mandatory.
conditions: The job fair is intended for Hope Ladder scholarship recipients.
steps: Read the two attached images (the poster and the web flyer for the 2026 Mid-sized Enterprise Job Fair in Daejeon) in the original notice for the event details; their content was not read for this translation.
Participate in the job fair if you are a Hope Ladder scholarship recipient.
translation:
[Korea Student Aid Foundation] Notice of a Job Fair for Hope Ladder Scholarship Recipients

The Korea Student Aid Foundation is holding a job fair in cooperation with various organisations to promote employment and business start-ups among Hope Ladder scholarship recipients. Eligible students are asked to participate.

Attachments (2):
2. [Poster] "2026 Mid-sized Enterprise Job Fair in Daejeon" (「2026년 중견기업 일자리 박람회 in 대전」).png (210 KB)
"2026 Mid-sized Enterprise Job Fair in Daejeon" web flyer (웹플라이어).png (1 MB)

[Note: The attachments are images whose content is not in the notice text; they were not read for this translation.]
